limitations: Finite vertical layout semantics only, not EUI compatibility.
Text widths are an external synthetic fixture, not real font/shaping/CJK/IME validation.
No timing, FPS, device, GPU, or performance-advantage claims.
Mutation validation traverses the entire source and dependency graphs; changed frames traverse all nodes for world state, with cached dimension recomputation.
Arbitrary subtree isolation is explicitly invalid when content-size ancestors or flow siblings depend on it.
